title: Do you clean offices outside normal hours?
body: Yes. Office cleaning can be scheduled early morning, evening, or weekend, depending on crew availability.

title: Can you provide a price during the call?
body: Yes. Atrium can provide a ballpark estimate once service type, area, room count, urgency, and timing are known.

title: Do you need photos?
body: For complex construction cleaning or unusual window jobs, photos may be requested after the call before a final quote is confirmed.

title: Move-out cleaning
body: Move-out cleaning includes kitchen, bathrooms, floors, inside cupboards, fixtures, and handover-ready final cleaning.

title: Office cleaning
body: Office cleaning covers workstations, floors, bins, kitchenette, bathrooms, and shared areas.

title: Window cleaning
body: Window cleaning covers interior glass, frames, sills, and accessible exterior windows.

title: Construction cleaning
body: Construction cleaning includes post-renovation dust removal, floor cleaning, debris-ready surface preparation, and final cleaning before handover.

title: Glanz AG pricelist (CHF)
body: Move-out: base 120 plus 4.50 per square meter. Office: base 90 plus 3.20 per square meter. Window: base 80 plus 5.00 per square meter, exterior may need review. Urgent jobs apply a 20 to 25 percent multiplier.
